```yaml
name: Close Old Bot Discussions

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs every day at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close-old-bot-discussions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run close-old-bot-discussions
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # If the project ships a Go binary for this task, run it directly.
          # Otherwise, fall back to a script in the repository.
          if [ -f ./cmd/close-old-bot-discussions/main.go ]; then
            go run ./cmd/close-old-bot-discussions/main.go
          elif [ -f ./scripts/close-old-bot-discussions.sh ]; then
            chmod +x ./scripts/close-old-bot-discussions.sh
            ./scripts/close-old-bot-discussions.sh
          else
            echo "No close-old-bot-discussions entry point found."
            exit 1
          fi
```
